motivation: Process multiple related histories directly instead of relying entirely on fixed aggregations. Official model exposes relational message passing and cached fit/predict.

initial_graph.task: Selected application and existing 90 V5 features, with customer_id typed as an ID link and decision time as a timestamp
initial_graph.relationships: Each child connects to its owning customer. Context and query customer subgraphs are disjoint.
initial_graph.sampling: Predeclare deterministic past-only sampling; latest rows plus history-spanning rows where useful. Never sample based on target labels.

safety_of_validation: Target exists only in y_context for outer-training customers. Related tables never contain target, split, or numeric ID predictors. Raw IDs are used only for graph links. Every observation must be available before that customer's decision cutoff.
preflight: First use a tiny synthetic graph to verify ID links, categorical/missing data, cached inference and disjoint context/query subgraphs. Then check a real-data subset for throughput before full five-fold evaluation.
limitations: OOF model and feature selection reuse previously used training labels and splits. New candidate public scores are unknown.
